x: We had great hopes however, of a placing with Stan Vickers, and Eric Hall, Kent and Surrey Champions, Syd James 2nd in the Surrey, George Checkley 5th in the Middlesex and Bob McMullen back from Canada and showing something like his old form, together with George Beecham, young Terry Clark and Ted Smith.

Twenty-three Club members took part in these walks and the most oustanding performance was that of Eric Hall in covering 7 miles 1635 yds. He was well backed up in the team race by N.Milsum, E.Smith and G.Checkley and we won from Met.W.C. by 36 pts. to 57.
